evidence_class: prospective secondary-taxon same-geography mechanism replication; not a geographically independent system
scientific_question: Among bird species supported on the frozen six pilot islands, is the held-out presence advantage of the observed island topology over matched rewired topologies stronger where pre-response source-configuration sensitivity is higher?

response_free_topology_surface.actual_graph: exact committed minimal-connected symmetrized 3-NN source operator
response_free_topology_surface.null_rule: degree-preserving double-edge swaps restricted to fixed actual-edge length quintiles; connectedness required; 80 accepted swaps per null
response_free_topology_surface.S_definition: S_i(n)=[(M-n)/(n(M-1))]*(sigma_i^2/mu_i^2) from actual-graph exponential source weights to the six frozen pilot islands

pilot_gate.response_access: pilot islands only; confirmatory island bird values remain sealed
pilot_gate.fixed_species_rule: include every bird species present on at least two distinct frozen pilot islands
pilot_gate.if_fail: STOP bird topology-sensitivity lane before any confirmatory response access; do not lower thresholds

actual_C_add: pilot-only nearest actual-graph path to occupied source
model_freeze_after_pilot.null_C_add: same two graph-path source features recomputed separately on each of the 20 frozen null graphs
model_freeze_after_pilot.fit: pooled binary ridge logistic regression; lambda=1; same deterministic IRLS rule as the completed beetle route
model_freeze_after_pilot.prediction_surface: all 13 confirmatory islands x all fixed bird species; R3, actual C and 20 null-C probabilities frozen before confirmatory response

primary.cell_loss_contrast_D: binary logloss(actual C) minus mean binary logloss across the 20 null-C models; negative favours observed topology
primary.moderator: z-standardized pre-response S_i(n_species), standardized over the complete frozen confirmatory prediction surface before response access
primary.estimand: weighted least-squares slope beta_S of D on zS, with each frozen spatial block carrying equal total weight among realized-presence cells
primary.uncertainty: 10000 deterministic bootstrap replicates resampling frozen confirmatory spatial blocks; type-7 95% interval
primary.if_unestimable: terminal non-estimable; no threshold or subgroup rescue

secondary_nonrescuing: equal-block mean actual-C minus mean-null-C loss on realized presences
actual C better than each of the 20 null-C models on realized-presence equal-block loss
all-cell beta_S using the same frozen D and zS surface

claim_boundary.can_support: taxonomic replication within the same 19-island geography that source scarcity/configuration sensitivity predicts where exact topology adds occurrence information
cannot_support: reversal or rescue of the completed beetle primary
